navigator.title: College Navigator - Boise State University (fall 2024 admissions summary)

stats.notes: CDS C1 (fall 2025 first-time first-year): 17,582 applied, 14,749 admitted (83.9%), 3,881 enrolled; residency table in-state 9,980/7,920, out-of-state 7,535/6,778, international 67/51 (76% admitted). Only about 67 international first-year applicants per year, so the international sample is small. In the 2025-26 CDS file the C7 factor boxes, C8 policy boxes, C9-C12 test-score/GPA tables and the G tuition table are blank in the text layer, so test scores, GPA and factors are not taken from it. Undergraduate enrollment is B1 'Total All Undergraduates' (25,308 incl. part-time and non-degree); 155 nonresident undergraduates is the B2 total column. No early decision/action; student-to-faculty ratio 20:1 (CDS I-2). Boise State is not test-blind for internationals (see test policy) but domestic admission ignores SAT/ACT.

stats_extra.notes: Fall 2024 first-year class from the 2024-25 CDS (the latest Boise State CDS whose GPA table is readable). C11 also lists 0.8% below 1.0 as printed, so the bands sum to about 100%. Residency: international 74 applied, 56 admitted, 13 enrolled. C9: 49% of enrollees submitted SAT (1,646) and 5% ACT (168); among submitters SAT composite 25th/75th percentile 960/1180, SAT ERW 490/610, ACT composite 20/26 (50th percentile and SAT math were not readable, so no score row is stored).
